At the center of the series is Meredith Grey, whose journey takes her from a young, uncertain intern to a skilled and respected surgeon. Alongside her, doctors like Miranda Bailey, Richard Webber, Amelia Shepherd, and Jo Wilson experience heartbreak, friendship, personal growth, and challenges that test their strength.

It was the wedding venue deposit refund.

We were supposed to get married in December. We had paid $3,500 for the venue, 150 guests, everything set. I proposed last year with my grandmother's ring. She cried for 20 minutes.

Last month, I called the venue to add 10 more chairs because my cousins said they would fly in. The manager said, "Oh, we already processed the full refund for you guys last week. Your fiancée said you wanted to postpone indefinitely. We sent $3,500 back to her account."

I said, "What refund? We never canceled."
